title: Lazy Loading
definition: Lazy loading is the practice of delaying the initialization or downloading of resources (images, JS chunks) until they are actually needed (e.g., scrolled into the viewport).
simpleExplanation: Don't download the pictures at the very bottom of the page until the user actually scrolls down there.

basic: How does Lazy Loading fundamentally work?

answers.answer: Lazy Loading is essential for complex frontend applications.
